items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: if I would find out Freddie Hubbard or somebody who knows, practice, for about two weeks. And when he comes in and plays, I would invite him somewhere to have a jam session.

ctx.x: Yeah, you know, like if a guy, like at one time, musicians used to be almost like prize fighters. If you find out a guy coming at the time, you're very good on a trick. Well, if you got a trick, like if I would find out Freddie Hubbard or somebody who knows, practice, for about two weeks. And when he comes in and plays, I would invite him somewhere to have a jam session. At that time, jam session was like a prize fighting match. Where everybody, well, this guy would try to, uh, to play this other way. I'd do a…
Well, some guys are boxers and some guys are sluggers. Yeah. And you can win by being a boxer, you can win by being a slugg, and the crowd likes sluggers.
